entries.statement: getChunkSeriesSet opens a ChunkQuerier, defers querier.Close(), and returns querier.Select(...). The returned storage.ChunkSeriesSet is lazy: the caller iterates it inside StreamChunkedReadResponses AFTER getChunkSeriesSet has returned, by which point the deferred Close() has already run. Closing the querier releases the block's pendingReaders, allowing TSDB to close and unmap the block's chunk files while the series set is still reading them — a use-after-close on memory-mapped chunk data. The previous code held the querier open for the whole streaming call via a defer in the caller's own scope.

entries.reviewer_visible_cue: The base file already contains a CORRECT sibling of this pattern: remoteReadSamples at :141-161 opens a querier, defers Close, and calls ToQueryResult(querier.Select(...)) — safe because ToQueryResult fully materializes the result before the closure returns. The difference between the two is exactly the lazy-vs-materialized distinction e1 turns on, and it is visible without leaving this file.
entries.must_flag: Flags that the ChunkSeriesSet returned by getChunkSeriesSet is consumed after the deferred querier.Close() has already run, so the querier does not outlive the data it produced. Equivalent framings count: 'Select is lazy, so closing the querier here invalidates the returned set', 'the deferred Close fires before the caller iterates', 'use-after-close / use-after-free on the chunk reader', 'the querier must outlive the series set', 'move Close to the caller or defer it until streaming completes'.
